caseNameFull: Federal Trade Commission v. Actavis, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. [Certiorari granted sub nom. Federal Trade Commission v. Watson Pharmaceuticals, Inc., et al., ante, p. 1066.] Motion of Enavail, LLC, for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument denied.

Justice Alito took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
